answer: Jury plus honeypot audits. Established peers receive random grading seats and must correctly reject occasional planted low-quality answers mixed into the pool. An attacker who tries to spin up many fake identities must sustain coherent high-quality grading for each identity while risking detection on the hidden honeypots, raising the cost of a Sybil swarm far above any possible reward. Crystal-clear scoring clears the dune of spam under a steady gale of scrutiny.
